category: Define Security Requirements for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Provide training and resources so that everyone involved in the software development process can understand and fulfil the security requirements.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AT-2, AT-3, SA-11
implementation_examples: Provide role-specific training on secure development (e.g., OWASP Top 10, language-specific secure coding)
Maintain an internal wiki of secure-coding guidance tied to the security requirements
Schedule refresher training annually and after any material change to requirements
assessment_objectives: Determine whether training is provided to all parties involved in software development.
Determine whether training records demonstrate role-appropriate secure-development competence.
